item.description: Good evening, Naresh! It's Tuesday, October 13th, 2026, here in Sydney, and with that persistent drizzle and a cool 16 degrees out there, it definitely feels like a night for a cozy playlist. As the day winds down, I hope you're ready to put your feet up and enjoy a well-deserved evening after whatever today threw your way. Did you know that the word "playlist" itself only really gained popularity with the advent of digital music players in the early 2000s? So, as you dive into your Daily Drive, stay safe if you're still on the road, have a wonderful rest of your evening, and we'll catch you back here tomorrow!
